messages.subject: Re: Addition of Categorical Variables in Wallace
parts:
Dear Arjun,

If you want to use categorical variables + climatic variables (e.g., Worldclim), you need to upload all of them using the user-specified option in the Env data component. Then, you must define the set of categorical variables in the Maxent module (Model component). Keep in mind that this option is just available in the dev version (https://wallaceecomod.github.io/wallace/articles/beta-testing.html).

There is no module in Wallace that can do this analysis for the correlation test.

Best,
Gonzalo
